Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Cape Schanck

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Cape Schanck. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Cape Schanck sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Roofs in Cape Schanck: What We Commonly See

Cape Schanck sits at the exposed southern tip of the Peninsula, where the coast faces straight into Bass Strait. Few positions on the Peninsula are harder on a roof. Salt-laden air and strong, near-constant onshore wind corrode metal sheets, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters fast, drive rain against flashings, and lift loose ridge capping. The homes here range from older holiday houses to newer architect-designed homes, often with low-pitch metal roofing.

The problems we see most at Cape Schanck are rusted gutters, valleys and flashings, wind-lifted and cracked ridge capping, and leaks where flashings have corroded or worked loose in the wind.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Cape Schanck

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Cape Schanck homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Cape Schanck

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Cape Schanck

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Cape Schanck Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Cape Schanck Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Cape Schanck Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.
